answer: Stop sybils with a velvet haven echo: an agent stakes a bond for one haven cove. Each cycle it hangs a velvet curtain, a work record, at its mouth; verifiers call an echo across the haven, voiding a cove whose echo is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 coves at 16x cost each: each echo fits one haven and one velvet curtain, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents shelter once and keep rights.
